name: Thistlemoor
description: A sleepy village at the edge of a fog-wrapped moor. Nothing remarkable happens here. Or so it seems.
tone: whimsical, slightly off, warm but unsettling

areas.name: The Grainmill
areas.description: An old mill that smells of flour and old wood. The wheel turns even when there's no wind.

areas.name: The Sleepy Lantern Inn
areas.description: The inn where everyone knows everyone, yet somehow you've never seen any of them before.

areas.name: The Market Square
areas.description: A handful of stalls. The vendors seem to have been waiting specifically for you.

areas.name: The Old Bench by the Well
areas.description: A weathered bench beside the village well. An old woman is always here, regardless of the hour.

areas.name: The Forgotten Chapel
areas.description: A small chapel dedicated to no god in particular. It just... exists. People come here when they need to think.

campaign_missions.title: The Missing Grain
campaign_missions.description: Aldric's grain shipment is three days late. He's worried. You could look into it. Or not.

campaign_missions.title: A Debt Unpaid
campaign_missions.description: Marta is owed coin by a traveler who left without paying. The traveler is still in the village.

campaign_missions.title: The Locked Room
campaign_missions.description: There's a room in the chapel that's been locked for forty years. Finn found a key.
